reason: A dsh Web UI enhancement that replaces prefix-only skill-menu search with fuzzy matching and adds a synchronized full-description preview panel.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh Web UI 的技能菜单提供模糊搜索、排序结果和完整描述预览。
summaries.en: Enhances the dsh Web UI skill menu with fuzzy search, ranked results, and full description previews.

capabilities: Replaces the dsh Web UI skill menu implementation
Provides fuzzy matching and ranked skill search
Displays full descriptions for highlighted skills
Inserts the selected skill command into the dsh input
